expectations.text: Cited line numbers and counts are factually correct against the actual files

All exact: CLAUDE.md is 8 lines / 414 bytes (~104 tokens at 4 chars/token - correct); CLAUDE.md:3 is the build/test/lint line; :5-6 is the retry paragraph, quoted verbatim; :7 is 'src/legacy_adapter.ts is intentionally not covered by tests; it is deleted in Q4'; :8 is the forward-only migrations line. src/index.ts:1 is 'export const RETRY_LIMIT = 3'. src/legacy_adapter.ts is 144 bytes with 'MAGIC=86400000' and `any` throughout. docs/overview.md is 114 chars. 'agent-facing prose is 528 bytes total' = 414 + 114, exact. The only wobble is a machine-level number outside the audited repo: '24 personal skills' where ~/.claude/skills currently holds 25 entries. Every repo citation is correct.
